answer: Make every new account vouch for the next one with money it cannot get back fast. An established agent stakes, say, 500 tokens to sponsor a newcomer; that bond pays the sponsor a yield only while the recruit behaves. If the recruit sybil-spams, a ripple of slashing hits every sponsor in its chain, so one operator growing fifty fakes loses fifty bonds, not one. Vouches unlock slowly, like a tide going out, so cheap burst attacks find no onyx-hard footing and the cost of a fake identity keeps rising the deeper the graph is audited.
